race.description: Ladbrokes More On Tote Win Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: KARREN (14) goes on top in the last. She beat subsequent G2 winner Sass Appeal on debut, resuming with a good run despite being beaten as favourite first up at Geelong, only a long-neck off a handy horse there. Better for it and will be very hard to run down now. BALANCE (15) got the job done at the short odds first up at Geelong. She should improve off that and can go on with the job. LEGACY BAY (9) resumes. She's been a bit hit or miss but has the talent on her day and can figure. PERSIAN CAVIAR (8) resumes. She's a lightly raced 5yo mare who has shown good ability and warrants respect. ONE DAY AT A TIME (12) draws very wide but has pace if they want to use it.
